youtube.baslik: Is understanding speech with a brainstem implant the same for everyone? #shorts
youtube.aciklama: In the 2009 study by Colletti and colleagues, mean open-set speech recognition with an auditory brainstem implant (ABI) was about 10 percent in patients with neurofibromatosis type 2 (NF2) and about 59 percent in adults without tumors. This difference is explained by the tumor and surgery in NF2 also being able to damage the cochlear nucleus; the values are averages from a single center.
